title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — Heb 1:6 second advent; Bellarmine/Chamierus
pass_a_gloss: Heb 1:6 also refutes him: it is not Christ's nativity but his second most glorious coming, as the Apostle's words and all of Ps 97 (from which they are taken) show. Bellarmine answered this learned reply with many reasons (De amiss. grat. 4.3), and after him Chamier more briefly (De hom. corrupt. 1.5.9).
pass_b_english: The other place also, Heb. 1. 6., refutes the learned man: for it is not to be understood of Christ's nativity, but of his second most glorious advent, as is plain from the Apostle's words, and from the whole of Ps. 97. from which they are taken. Moreover Bellarmine refuted this reply of the learned man with many reasons in book 4. de amiss. Grat. chapter 3. and after him Chamier, but more briefly, in book 1. de hom. corrupt. chapter 5. section 9.
source_text: Alter quoque Heb. 1. 6. virum doctum refellit: intelligendus enim non est de nativitate Christi, sed de secundo eius gloriosissimo adventu, ut patet ex verbis Apostoli, & toto Ps. 97. unde sunt desumpta. Caeterum hanc viri docti responsionem refutavit Bellarminus multis rationibus lib. 4. de amiss. Grat. cap. 3. & post eum Chamierus, sed brevius, lib. 1. de hom. corrupt. cap. 5. §. 9.
